## Project

**Name:**
**URL:**
**Category:** (Wallets / DEX / DeFi / Games / Dev tools / Learning / something else?)

## Description (under 140 chars)

A one-line factual description, in the format used in the README:

```
- [Name](url) — short factual description.
```

## Why it belongs

What problem does it solve for a TON user / developer? Has it actually shipped?

## Conflict of interest

Are you affiliated with the project? Did anyone pay you to propose it?

## Checklist

- [ ] URL is live and points to a working product.
- [ ] Project is TON-relevant, not just crypto-adjacent.
- [ ] Description avoids promotional words ("best", "leading", etc.).
- [ ] Not a duplicate of an existing entry.
